description: Synthetic GPT-4-generated children's stories, cleaned by dataset publisher.
attribution: TinyStoriesV2_cleaned by Fachhochschule S?dwestfalen (fhswf); source stories generated by GPT-4. Original TinyStories authors are acknowledged by the dataset publisher.
sharing_notes: If publishing source or modified data, publish under unmodified CDLA-Sharing-1.0, preserve provider attribution/links, and prominently mark modifications. CDLA section 3.5 places no obligations on Results that contain no more than a de minimis portion of source data.

selection.method: Sort unique story text SHA-256 selection keys ascending; take the first requested records. Train/validation are disjoint partitions of the selected official train shard; test stories come only from the official test shard.
selection.preservation: Split on publisher <|endoftext|> separator, discard only that terminal marker, normalize line endings to LF, trim only outer whitespace; internal paragraph newlines, dialogue, punctuation, and sentence text are retained.
